instruction: Take the bread with golden crust and put it in the black skillet.

source.instruction: Take the bread with golden crust and put it in the black skillet.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the skillet, which was at x = -15 (left half of the table); the RIGHT arm grasped the bread, which was at x = +21 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Point left gripper down, move toward skillet handle at (-15, -11, 84).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+15, +8, -10) cm, now 8 cm (horizontal) / +10 cm (vertical) from the skillet

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-15, -12, 84) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper above bread at (22, -17, 94), orient yaw to match bread angle.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-9, +2, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the bread

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-15, -12, 84) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (21, -17, 94) opening 0.95; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right arm by 10 cm towards bread to z=84.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -10) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +10 cm (vertical) from the bread

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-15, -12, 84) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (22, -17, 84) opening 0.95; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left arm by 7.5 cm to z=76.5 to reach skillet handle.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -7) cm, now 8 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the skillet

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-15, -11, 78) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (22, -17, 84) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right arm to z=77 around bread, then close both grippers to grasp skillet and bread.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 8 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the skillet; closed the gripper (opening 0.14: holding the skillet); RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, -6) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the bread; closed the gripper (opening 0.56: holding the bread)

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-15, -11, 78) opening 0.14; RIGHT fingertips (21, -17, 78) opening 0.56; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift both arms up by 10 cm to z=88.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, +10) cm, now 8 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the skillet; RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, +10) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the bread

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-15, -11, 87) opening 0.14; RIGHT fingertips (21, -17, 87) opening 0.58; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm forward and rightward to position skillet closer to center at (-10, -5, 88).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+5, +6, +1) cm, now 8 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the skillet

frames.label: turn 8
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-10, -5, 88) opening 0.14; RIGHT fingertips (21, -17, 87) opening 0.58; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate left gripper yaw -90 deg to orient skillet flat towards center, lower slightly to z=82.5.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, -5) cm, now 8 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the skillet

frames.label: turn 9
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-10, -5, 83) opening 0.14; RIGHT fingertips (21, -17, 87) opening 0.58; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right arm leftwards by 18 cm towards x=3 above skillet.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-18, +0, +0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the bread

frames.label: turn 10
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-10, -5, 83) opening 0.14; RIGHT fingertips (3, -17, 88) opening 0.59; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right arm forward by 10.5 cm to y=-6.5 directly over the skillet pan to complete placement.
